supports: Letting Americans keep more of what they earn
positions.quote: Affordability starts with letting Americans keep more of what they earn.
positions.impact: He would vote for further federal tax cuts. As one of 435 House members, they would vote and push for this in Congress; it would only become law with majorities in both chambers and the President's signature.

opposes: Insurance companies and bureaucrats controlling health care
positions.quote: We must restore the bond between patients and their doctors, not insurance companies and bureaucrats who wish to control the system.
positions.impact: Expect support for measures limiting insurer and government control over treatment decisions. The site doesn't name a specific bill.

supports: A forceful military response to any terrorist acts by Iran and its allied groups
positions.quote: Hamas, Hezbollah, the Houthis, and the Terror Republic of Iran must know that any acts of terrorism will be responded to with relentless and unmatched force.
positions.impact: He would vote for military funding and action against Iran and allied groups. Congress controls war funding, but the President directs military operations.

supports: No federal tax on tips, overtime or Social Security
positions.quote: That means building off the success of the Trump tax cuts - including lifting the SALT tax cap to protect New York families and eliminating taxes on tips, overtime, and Social Security.
positions.impact: Homeowners in high-tax areas, tipped and hourly workers, and retirees would pay less federal tax. As one of 435 House members, they would vote and push for this in Congress; it would only become law with majorities in both chambers and the President's signature.

supports: Deporting people here illegally who commit crimes
Requiring all immigrants to enter legally
positions.quote: We must continue to deport those criminals here illegally and demand that every immigrant - like our parents and grandparents - enter this country legally and with pride.
positions.impact: He would vote for stronger deportation and border enforcement. As one of 435 House members, they would vote and push for this in Congress; it would only become law with majorities in both chambers and the President's signature.

supports: Full support for police officers and their families
positions.quote: These officers and their families deserve and have earned our full and unapologetic support.
positions.impact: Expect support for federal funding for police. Day-to-day policing is run by local police departments.

opposes: Boycotts, divestment and sanctions against Israel
positions.quote: Any attempt to boycott, divest from, or sanction Israel must be shut down, eliminated, and swiftly dealt with.
positions.impact: He would vote for federal limits on boycotts of Israel. As one of 435 House members, they would vote and push for this in Congress; it would only become law with majorities in both chambers and the President's signature.
